newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht down late, interbank rate steady.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht down late, interbank rate steady.

text.p: The Thai baht was lower against the U.S. dollar in late trade on Thursday as offshore players bought dollars to cover their short positions ahead of a long weekend, dealers said.
"There was some dollar short covering in the afternoon. Offshore players bought the dollar as Friday is a holiday," said one dealer at a U.S. bank.
The baht was quoted at 26.010/26.020 to the dollar late from 26.008/26.013 in morning trade, dealers said.
Local banks also purchased the dollar due to the ample baht liquidity in the banking system, dealers said.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate at 25.99 per dollar, unchanged from Wednesday.

The overnight interbank rate was steady at 7.00 percent, unchanged from the morning, dealers said. The one-month baht/dollar swap premium dipped to 5.50/6.50 satangs per dollar late from 6.50/7.50 earlier.
"The market was very quiet as very few borrowers entered the market," said one money market dealer.
Dealers said the liquidity was very high due to the launch of state pension and provident funds amounting to about 80 billion baht ($3.0 billion) today.--Anuchit Nguyen 662-652-0642
